note: Vernon County's oldest park, in a Driftless valley on the North Fork Bad Axe River between Westby and Coon Valley. Hookup sites line the park road beside a stocked trout pond; the rustic sites spread across an open meadow along the river. Hiking trails and a picnic shelter, with a nine-hole golf course next door. --Claude

Possible creekside for 13-16 only if a reviewer wants it; not proposed.
